name: Dumbbell rear-foot-elevated split squat
definition: Use a split stance with the rear foot supported on a bench and a dumbbell in each hand. Bend the front hip and knee to lower, then return along the same path.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Use a split stance with the rear foot supported on a bench and a dumbbell in each hand.
value.movement: Bend the front hip and knee to lower, then return along the same path.
value.finish: Finish in the original split stance and record the lead leg.
value.range_of_motion: Repeatable depth with the rear support and front foot position unchanged.
